submitted.rationale: Of the 3 merit measurements, index 4 (Bi0.18 Cu0.34 V0.48) gave the highest photocurrent, 3.73e-5 A. That is about 30x the BiVO4-like composition (index 7, 1.24e-6 A) and above index 41 (2.59e-5 A), which has less Bi and more Cu. The best region seems to be V-rich (V about 0.48) with Bi around 0.18 and Cu around 0.34. Moving further toward low Bi / high Cu lowered the photocurrent.

rejected.reason: Measured 1.24e-6 A. The Bi:V about 1:1 (BiVO4-like) region is weak in this Cu-containing library.
Measured 2.59e-5 A, below index 4. Lowering Bi and raising Cu past index 4 reduced the photocurrent.
